* If Light exhausts their Reserve Deck stacking destinies but the total is still not > 12, all of the following apply:All of the ''stacked'' destiny cards are returned to Reserve Deck in their original order.Any destiny cards that were not stacked (e.g. taken into hand, lost, etc) are not returned.This [[Kessel Run (V)]] card returns to the owner's hand.[[Kessel Run (V)]] may not attempt deployment again this turn.
* If Light attempts to deploy this with an empty Reserve Deck, it will return to Light's hand and it may not attempt deployment again this turn.
* Cards that are 'destiny +X when drawn for destiny' (e.g. [[Tobias Beckett]]) do not apply that destiny bonus while stacked here.
